from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's beginning cash balance extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this filing belongs to")
    amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the balance as written (e.g., '549,755' or '9,779')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    date_as_of: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance is as of (e.g., 'December 31, 2023')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label as written in the document (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalanceRecord]
